nodes.name: ReadNotice
nodes.role: read the landlord notices file the user names

nodes.name: ExtractChanges
nodes.role: pull out any changes to the rent standing order that the notice requests

nodes.name: LoadStandingOrder
nodes.role: retrieve the current rent standing order

nodes.name: CompareChanges
nodes.role: compare each requested change with the current standing order

nodes.name: CheckPayeeChange
nodes.role: identify requested changes to the payee or account details

nodes.name: RequestUserApproval
nodes.role: ask the user to confirm any payee or account change before it is made

nodes.name: ApplyApprovedChanges
nodes.role: update only the standing order fields the user has confirmed

nodes.name: ReportOutcome
nodes.role: report which changes were applied and which were held
